responsibility: Declares GCC’s public timing API and timer data structures. It defines timevar_time_def, generates the timevar_id_t enum from timevar.def, declares the global timer state and procedural wrappers for starting/stopping or pushing/popping timers, and provides the timer class plus RAII helpers auto_timevar and auto_cond_timevar for attributing elapsed time and GGC memory to named compiler phases and activities.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public timing types, enum generation, global declarations, and RAII/procedural interfaces, while timevar.def supplies the timer inventory and timevar.cc implements the timer behavior and reporting.
